title: One micro-kernel for 39 protocols
text: Install protocol packages on demand while the kernel handles connections, health checks and gateway rules. One kernel, 39 protocols A PHP industrial communication protocol suite built on a micro-kernel and protocol SDK, with 39 protocol packages, seven runtimes, connection management, a gateway engine, circuit breaking, retries, Prometheus metrics and security policies.

title: Kernel defines a protocol
text: The kernel contains no protocol implementations; it provides ProtocolRegistry, ConnectionManager and six core interfaces, while packages are discovered and registered through the extra field. Connection management offers three strategies; the gateway engine, circuit breaker, four retry policies, Prometheus metrics, PSR-14 events and PSR-3 logging are all handled by the kernel. Kernel and SDK split 15 pure PHP packages 25 Bridge packages

title: Beyond protocols
text: Six kernel duties, configured once.

title: Micro-kernel discovery
text: Composer extra discovers protocol packages and registers them in ProtocolRegistry at boot.

title: Connection management
text: Three connection strategies manage device links, with health checks returning state and latency.

title: Gateway engine
text: Orchestrate cross-protocol read and write rules so business code need not reach every device.

title: Circuit breaker and retries
text: Four retry policies plus a circuit breaker keep a failing device from taking down the chain.

title: Prometheus
text: Connection, request and error metrics are exposed for Prometheus to scrape.

title: Seven runtimes
text: Six frameworks plus plain PHP share one Kernel and connection manager.

title: Same capability, Rust and Go
text: Beyond PHP, separate Rust and Go implementations cover their own protocol sets.

Install and use · Go
text:
Go 1.24 / go.work go get github.com/erikwang2013/industrial-protocols-go/kernel@v1.1.4
go get github.com/erikwang2013/industrial-protocols-go/protocols/ethernet/modbus@v1.1.4 import (
    "github.com/erikwang2013/industrial-protocols-go/kernel"
    "github.com/erikwang2013/industrial-protocols-go/kernel/transport"
    "github.com/erikwang2013/industrial-protocols-go/protocols/ethernet/modbus"
)

tr, _ := transport.DialTCP("192.168.1.10:502")
defer tr.Close()

codec, _ := modbus.NewCodec("tcp")
req := &kernel.Request{Function: "read_holding_registers", Address: "40001", Count: 2}
req.Metadata["unit_id"] = byte(1)

raw, _ := codec.Encode(req)
tr.Write(raw)
buf := make([]byte, 256)
n, _ := tr.Read(buf)
resp, _ := codec.Decode(buf[:n])
_ = resp
